statement: Predicted before any cross-engine comparison. Recorded 2026-11-12. It states, per member count, how far a plain translational lumped-mass formulation is expected to differ from SWBPIPE's stated formulation on these cases, so that when sealed captures are opened the expected convention difference is on record from before and is not fitted afterwards. It is a prediction about a formulation, not about any program: whether another program's mass formulation is this one is not asserted.
number_format: Inputs are binary64 ('binary64' shortest round trip, 'hex', 'exact' rational). Derived reals are decimal strings with 40 significant digits and the nearest binary64. rel_dev and cross-check residuals are short diagnostics. SI units.

definitions.relative_difference: lumped / consistent - 1, from the published 40-digit decimals of pack_summary.json; [decimal with 6 significant digits, nearest binary64 of the quotient]
definitions.consistent: the generator's planar FE with the consistent mass SWBPIPE states (DEL-04-09 REQ-001)
definitions.lumped: the half-and-half translational lumped mass: half of each member's mass at each end translation, no rotary inertia

kinds.force_or_moment: element forces and moments (none among case C's compared quantities)
kinds.support_reaction: base and tip reaction forces and moments

definitions.omitted: rows where either value is null (mid-span at N = 1; the lumped N = 1 Z plane; case D)

cases.note: no consistent and lumped values in this package for this case: the N = 8 values of case D are the sibling discrete package's

cross_checks.what: the rows are taken from the pairs pack_summary.json publishes (the generated file read back equals the rows used)
